Seller.title: Seller
Seller.description: Represents a seller in the Koop application.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns this seller profile. Optional for prototyping.

courseName.description: The name of the golf course.

courseAddress.description: The physical address of the golf course.

latitude.description: The latitude of the golf course.

longitude.description: The longitude of the golf course.

contactName.description: The primary contact person for the seller.

contactEmail.description: The contact email address for the seller.

contactPhone.description: The contact phone number for the seller.

serviceFee.description: The service fee charged by the seller.

status.description: The current status of the seller.

Menu.title: Menu
Menu.description: Represents a menu offered by a seller.

id.description: Unique identifier for the menu entity.

name.description: The name of the menu (e.g., 'Beer Menu', 'Snacks').

MenuItem.title: MenuItem
MenuItem.description: Represents a single item on a menu.

id.description: Unique identifier for the menu item entity.

name.description: The name of the menu item (e.g., 'Bud Light', 'Chips').

description.description: A description of the menu item.

price.description: The price of the menu item.

category.description: The category of the menu item.

imageUrl.description: URL of the menu item image.

definition.description: Stores seller profiles. Each document represents a seller in the Koop application.

params.name: sellerId
params.description: The unique identifier of the seller.

definition.description: Stores menus associated with a specific seller.  The 'sellerId' field within the menu document is redundant but is denormalized here for authorization independence; it allows rules to validate that the menu belongs to the seller, without requiring a 'get()' call to the parent 'seller' document. This supports secure list operations. The menu object includes the sellerId.

params.name: sellerId
params.description: The unique identifier of the seller.

params.name: menuId
params.description: The unique identifier of the menu.

definition.description: Stores menu items associated with a specific menu. The 'menuId' field within the menuItem document is redundant but is denormalized here for authorization independence; it allows rules to validate that the menuItem belongs to the menu, without requiring a 'get()' call to the parent 'menu' document. This supports secure list operations. The menuItem object includes the menuId.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to efficiently manage seller, menu, and menu item data for the Koop application, while adhering to the principles of Authorization Independence and QAPs.  We leverage hierarchical paths for ownership, associating menus and menu items directly with sellers. There is no need for collaborative access, therefore, membership maps are not required. Segregation by collection is implicit in the design.
